reviews.name: Zuz
reviews.body: I just started using it so nothing much to report yet, but it leaves the skin nice and hydrated.

reviews.name: Coco
reviews.body: I've been using it for 2 weeks now and it's very hydrating. I feel my skin moisturized and glowing. I use it in the morning juste after washing my face. I think it's a great value for the price.

reviews.name: Sunny
reviews.body: Tried this face mask for the first time. It’s very hydrating, and the results are visible.

reviews.name: Emilia
reviews.body: I discovered this in February, it was a gift a friend uses religiously, and she converted me to this brand! My skin is more radiant, my fine lines less visible, and my skin glows, I'm in my 3rd purchase!

reviews.name: Qwendy
reviews.body: I'm completely flummoxed by the two sided pad which I can't perceive, being completely saturated with serum. The serum is lovely and hydrating but I don't understand why it has to be in this enormous jar with a tweezer and on these pads? It's very moisturizing but takes up a lot of space in my tiny bathroom!

reviews.name: Luci
reviews.body: Skin is left very well hydrated, I am already repurchising.

reviews.name: Maria_London
reviews.body:
I like these patches and find them juicy and hydrating.
I just think that I prefer the shape of traditional sheet masks and eye patches, as I feel like they hug better the contours of the face that I personally want to target.

reviews.name: Lyssa
reviews.body: I have dehydrated skin, not dry skin, so it’s hard to find products that give my skin water-based hydration rather than something heavy or greasy. This product is honestly amazing,it feels so fresh. It’s also really economical because I don’t use three patches each time; I just use one or two on my cheeks, then my forehead, and massage the remaining product into my skin until it’s fully absorbed. I’m left with a glass-skin effect, plump skin, and when I apply my moisturizer on top, it looks incredible.

reviews.name: Lucia
reviews.body: It hydrates my skin, calms redness and it's pefect under makeup.

reviews.name: kovesdii
reviews.body: They moisturize really well and don't irritate my sensitive skin.
